question: Where does tunnel64 state a terms or fair-use page for the free 6in4 tunnel, and does the sign-up flow show one?
why: tunnel64.net/terms, free.tunnel64.net/terms and free.tunnel64.net/faq answered HTTP 404 and free.tunnel64.net/signup could not be read; only the paid VPN has terms (vpn.tunnel64.net/terms), so a byte cap or fair-use line for the free tunnel could sit behind the sign-up.
